title: User preferences get an API
summary:
Preferences got an API, ads got clearer labels, PixPal joined the catalog, and the image cache got its imports sorted.

Authenticated GET and POST `/preferences` endpoints were added for reading and updating one setting or several at once. GPT Image edits also now use the uploaded image’s Content-Type when naming files.

Affiliate and fallback ads now carry an Ad label, including in streaming responses. Redirect target IDs are sanitized before lookup, and image ads were disabled.

The community project list added PixPal, a chat assistant for image work, building websites from screenshots, creating 3D games, and writing blog posts.

highlights.title: User preferences API
highlights.text: Read and update individual preferences or multiple settings through authenticated GET and POST `/preferences` requests. [Explore the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
